title.description: Short title of the review, summarizing the user's feedback. Required for all published reviews.

body.description: Main review text content. Minimum 10; maximum 1000 characters. Editable within the allowed window as per business policy.

is_draft.description: Draft state indicator: true if not yet published, false if visible/published.

moderation_status.description: Moderation status code ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', etc.). See moderation workflow rules for details.

moderation_reason.description: Optional text providing reason for moderation decision (if any).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the review was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the review was last updated (by user or moderator).

deleted_at.description: Timestamp if soft deleted (platform removal), otherwise null.

customer.description: Customer who authored the review. Always present as contextual reference object.

customerSession.description: Customer session at review creation. Audit traceability and session context.

product.description: Reviewed product context. Only .ISummary is included to avoid deep expansion.

productSku.description: SKU/variant of the product being reviewed. .ISummary variant only.

order.description: Order in which the product/sku was purchased. .ISummary type for context.

orderItem.description: Specific order item this review was written for. .ISummary provides purchased quantity and item info.

rating.description: Rating record object for this review and SKU. Only includes summary info.

IShoppingMallReview.description: Comprehensive product review record, representing customer-authored feedback on a product SKU. This version transforms all contextual FKs (customer, session, product, SKU, order, order item, rating) to reference objects using .ISummary types in place of raw UUID values. Used in API responses and always returns complete contextual information for rendering and traceability.

title.description: Short summary/title of the review. Required for all published reviews. Must be provided and non-empty when publishing.

body.description: Body text of the review. Minimum 10 characters, maximum 1000. Editable by customer within allowed window.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Product that the review is about. Must match the purchased product in the order item.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: SKU of the product reviewed. Must match the purchased SKU in the order item.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Order in which this review's product was purchased. Used to validate purchase verification.

shopping_mall_order_item_id.description: Specific order item this review is linked to. Uniqueness constraint: One review per order item.

shopping_mall_product_rating_id.description: Rating record for this review and SKU. Links this review with its quantitative score.

is_draft.description: Indicates if the review is a draft (not yet published). System may set this based on context. Required.

moderation_status.description: Current moderation status, such as 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', or 'flagged'. System assigns this on creation.

withdrawn_at.description: Timestamp if the customer withdraws the review (soft delete for user-initiated removal). Null if review is not withdrawn.

IShoppingMallReview.ICreate.description:
DTO for request body of review creation. Represents the properties required to create a new product review for a purchased product SKU/order item.

Fields cover content (title, body), purchase verification (product, SKU, order, order item), rating association, moderation/draft status, and soft-withdrawal. Uniqueness on order item ensures only one review per purchase. Used in POST /shoppingMall/reviews.

title.description: Short summary/title of the review. Optionally updated by the author.

body.description: Body text of the review to update. Minimum 10 characters, maximum 1000.

is_draft.description: Indicates if the review should be changed between draft and published status.

moderation_status.description: Current moderation status to set (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'flagged'). Requires proper permissions and context.

moderation_reason.description: Optional field indicating the reason for rejection or flagging during moderation.

withdrawn_at.description: Timestamp to mark withdrawal (user-initiated soft delete).

IShoppingMallReview.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating an existing review in shopping_mall_reviews. Allows optional modification of review content, status, or withdrawal tracking. Used in PUT /shoppingMall/customer/reviews/{reviewId}.

Fields are all optional. System enforces edit period, moderation permissions, and traceability. Business rules require minimum/maximum body length and one update per order item. No ownership or linkage changes allowed.

reviewId.description: Unique identifier of the reviewed customer review (shopping_mall_reviews.id) for which to fetch associated seller responses.

moderation_status.description: Filter responses by current moderation status. Optional.

withdrawn_at_from.description: Filters for responses withdrawn after this timestamp. Optional.

withdrawn_at_to.description: Filters for responses withdrawn before this timestamp. Optional.

seller_id.description: Filters responses by the seller who authored them. Optional.

created_at_from.description: Filters for responses created after this timestamp. Optional.

created_at_to.description: Filters for responses created before this timestamp. Optional.

updated_at_from.description: Filters for responses updated after this timestamp. Optional.

updated_at_to.description: Filters for responses updated before this timestamp. Optional.

oneOf.description: Designates which field to sort responses by. Allowed values: created_at, updated_at, moderation_status. Optional.
Designates which field to sort responses by. Allowed values: created_at, updated_at, moderation_status. Optional.
Designates which field to sort responses by. Allowed values: created_at, updated_at, moderation_status. Optional.

sort_by.description: Designates which field to sort responses by. Allowed values: created_at, updated_at, moderation_status. Optional.

oneOf.description: Sort direction for results. Allowed values: asc, desc. Optional.
Sort direction for results. Allowed values: asc, desc. Optional.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for results. Allowed values: asc, desc. Optional.

page.description: Results page number (starting from 1). Optional.

limit.description: How many responses to return per page (max 100). Optional.

IShoppingMallReviewResponse.IRequest.description:
Request filter/pagination options for searching seller responses (shopping_mall_review_responses) for a given customer review. Enables sorting by audit and moderation status, creation/update/withdrawal date, and seller. Fields are optional except reviewId, which targets the relevant review context.

Use this request to efficiently filter and page through responses for a moderation, seller or admin review panel. All fields except reviewId are optional to give users flexible access to desired subsets of data.

This schema matches the moderator/admin search operation on review response listings.

id.description: Primary key for the seller response entity. Unique for every review response created.

body.description: Textual response from seller. Minimum 10, maximum 1000 characters.

withdrawn_at.description: Timestamp if seller withdraws or deletes their response. Nullable.

moderation_status.description: Current moderation status for the response. Platform-specific enum (e.g., pending, approved, rejected, flagged).

moderation_reason.description: Optional reason for moderation action (rejection/flagging). Nullable.

created_at.description: When the response was created.

updated_at.description: Last updated time.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker (for admin/content removal). Value is null unless deleted.

review.description: Reference to the original review that this seller response addresses.

seller.description: Reference to the seller who wrote this response.

IShoppingMallReviewResponse.description:
Seller response to a customer review posted on a product in the shopping mall.

Links uniquely to a customer review (IShoppingMallReview.ISummary) and seller account (IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary), using the full context object to avoid N+1 lookups. Contains the body of the response, moderation status, optional withdrawal and soft delete info, audit fields, and traceability via session and timestamps.

Each review can have at most one seller response. Only the associated seller or admin can create, update, or withdraw a response. Audit and status fields support moderation, transparency, and compliance workflows.

IShoppingMallReviewResponse.ICreate.description:
DTO for creating a new seller response to a customer product review (shopping_mall_review_responses table).

This schema is used as the request body for the operation that allows a product's seller to publicly respond to a customer review. Only the actual product's seller is authorized to create a response, enforced via authentication (seller context).

Each review is allowed exactly one seller response; this DTO is used for the initial creation. Provenance fields such as seller ID and session ID are server-managed and MUST NOT be included in this request DTO (extracted from authentication/session context).

Moderation status must be set at time of creation. Only the text body of the response and moderation status (with optional moderation reason) are present in the payload.

The target review ID is always supplied via the API operation path parameter; it must NOT be duplicated in the request body.

Security: Absolutely omit seller_id, session_id, review_id; these are derived from context and path, not accepted in the body.

body.description: Textual response from the seller to the customer review. Must be between 10 and 1000 characters, not blank, and should comply with platform guidelines for appropriate language and content.

moderation_status.description: Moderation status assigned to this response at creation (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'). Value should comply with allowed platform statuses. Mandatory at creation.

moderation_reason.description: Optional reason for moderation action, only supplied if the status is a moderation outcome (such as rejection or flagged). Omit or use null if moderation is not applicable.

IShoppingMallReviewResponse.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating an existing seller response to a customer product review (shopping_mall_review_responses table).

Used as the request body for the operation that permits a seller (or authorized admin) to modify their posted response to a review. Edits may include the textual response, moderation status, reason, or withdrawal marker.

Ownership and permission to edit must be enforced by middleware/service layer; seller_id, session_id, and response/review identifiers must NOT be present in this payload (derived from context and path).

All fields are optional to allow partial updates. Providing 'withdrawn_at' marks the response as withdrawn by seller/admin. Moderation status and reason can also be updated.

Security: Absolutely omit seller_id, session_id, review_id; these are managed externally and must not appear in updates.

body.description: Updated seller response text, between 10 and 1000 characters. If omitted, the original text remains unchanged.

moderation_status.description: Updated moderation status for the response (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'). If omitted, the existing value is unchanged.

moderation_reason.description: Optional updated moderation reason. Use only when moderation action is taken. Null or omit to clear the reason.

withdrawn_at.description: Timestamp marking response as withdrawn. If present and non-null, the response is considered withdrawn/deleted by the seller or admin. Omit or send null if not withdrawing; only the service layer can update this.

IShoppingMallProductRating.IRequest.description:
Query and search parameters for advanced, paginated product rating searches over the shopping_mall_product_ratings table. All fields map directly to the underlying Prisma columns for consistent filter and index support. Property names are aligned to their Prisma schema counterparts for audit and query traceability.

Intended for admin or seller patch query endpoints to analyze, moderate, or report on product ratings with explicit mapping to actual store columns.

created_at.description: Filter by creation date. shopping_mall_product_ratings.created_at.

updated_at.description: Filter by update date. shopping_mall_product_ratings.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Filter by soft delete field. shopping_mall_product_ratings.deleted_at.

page.description: Pagination: Page number, starts at 1. Used for paginated queries.

limit.description: Pagination: Records per page (max 100).

oneOf.description: Sort by creation timestamp.
Sort by star rating value.

sort_by.description: Sort field, must be 'created_at' or 'value'. Defaults to 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Ascending order.
Descending order.

sort_order.description: Sorting order; defaults to 'desc'.

IShoppingMallProductRating.description:
Standalone product rating entity representing a numeric rating (1–5 stars) a verified customer assigns to a product SKU, as stored in the shopping_mall_product_ratings table.

This type contains full audit traceability fields and explicit mappings for all relevant foreign keys. All relationship, ownership, and reference fields are exposed both as objects (summaries) and as UUIDs mapping directly to their respective Prisma columns. This allows unambiguous linking to the database representation by API consumers and full support for update, audit, and reporting use cases.

Business rules such as uniqueness constraints, value range, and update permissions follow the shopping_mall_product_ratings Prisma schema. Relationship summaries provide display context, while raw foreign ID fields ensure precise integration and reference.

Soft-delete handling and audit trail timestamps are directly mapped to the deleted_at, created_at, and updated_at columns for compliance and moderation.

id.description: Primary key of the product rating entity. Directly maps to shopping_mall_product_ratings.id.

customer.description: Summary of customer who provided the rating. Derived from shopping_mall_customers. For display/reference use.

session.description: Customer session during which the rating was submitted. Maps to shopping_mall_customer_sessions. Included for audit and eligibility trace.

product.description: Summary of rated product. References shopping_mall_products. Intended for display, search, and commerce context.

productSku.description: Summary of product SKU/variant. References shopping_mall_product_skus. Used for analytics/view context.

order.description: Order associated with this rating. References shopping_mall_orders. Used for audit, permissions, and review linkage.

order_item_id.description: Order item this rating applies to. Maps to shopping_mall_order_items.id.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Customer who provided the rating. Direct foreign key from shopping_mall_product_ratings.shopping_mall_customer_id.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description: Session ID from shopping_mall_product_ratings.shopping_mall_customer_session_id. Used to verify submission context and audit eligibility.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Order ID associated with this rating. shopping_mall_product_ratings.shopping_mall_order_id foreign key.

shopping_mall_order_item_id.description: Foreign key for order item in shopping_mall_product_ratings.shopping_mall_order_item_id.

value.description: Numeric rating assigned by the customer. Range [1,5]. Maps to shopping_mall_product_ratings.value.

created_at.description: Timestamp of rating creation in UTC. Maps to shopping_mall_product_ratings.created_at.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update (UTC). shopping_mall_product_ratings.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker; shopping_mall_product_ratings.deleted_at. Null if record is active.

shopping_mall_product_sku_id.description: ID of the SKU of the rated product. Must correspond to an existing shopping_mall_product_skus record owned by the customer.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: ID of the order associated with this rating. Must reference a valid shopping_mall_orders record that the customer owns.

shopping_mall_order_item_id.description: ID of the specific order item this rating applies to. This must match a record in shopping_mall_order_items within the corresponding order.

value.description: Integer rating value given by the customer, must be in the range 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).

IShoppingMallProductRating.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating a new product rating in the shopping mall platform.

Submitted by an authenticated customer to rate a specific product SKU for an order item. Enforces uniqueness on (customer, sku, order item). Authentication and session-related fields are provided by the system, not by the client.

value.description: Updated integer rating (1–5) to assign to the product SKU. Must be within valid range.

IShoppingMallProductRating.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing product rating in the shopping mall platform.

Allows an authenticated customer to change their rating value for a purchased product SKU/order item, within allowed business rules.

IShoppingMallReviewStatusHistory.IReques.description:
Request DTO for searching, filtering, and paginating status/moderation history records for a specific product review, focused on audit/compliance workflows.

This DTO supports advanced server-side filtering, full-text searching of status changes, and sorting/pagination for reviewing moderation history records in administrator mod audit dashboards. Note: The ID of the review being queried is never included in this DTO and is always provided in the endpoint path parameter (see /shoppingMall/admin/reviews/{reviewId}/statusHistories).

Property options allow filtering by status, actor type, actor ID, and date range, as well as comprehensive search and sort options. All filter parameters are optional and may be omitted for unfiltered behavior. Page and limit are always required to enforce pagination in audit and compliance interfaces.

status.description:
Optionally filter status history entries by the resultant review status (e.g., created, published, rejected, flagged, withdrawn, deleted).

If omitted, all statuses are included in the result set. Accepts any business-defined status value from moderation workflow requirements.

actor_type.description:
Optional: Filter by the type of actor who performed each status event. Acceptable values: 'customer', 'seller', 'admin'.

Leave unset to search all actor types.

actor_id.description:
UUID of a specific actor (customer, seller, or admin) responsible for the event. Set to search for a particular actor's actions across moderation/audit history.

If omitted, any actor is matched.

start_at.description: Filter to history records created on or after this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp. Optional; unset for no lower bound.

end_at.description: Filter to records created on or before this UTC ISO 8601 timestamp. Optional; unset for no upper bound.

search.description: Full-text search string for reason/justification content or actor names. Optional; leave omitted to match all records.

sort_by.description: Result sorting field. Only 'created_at' is supported for the review status history resource.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: ascending by created_at (chronological).
Sort direction: descending by created_at (latest first).

order.description: Sort direction: ascending or descending by created_at.

page.description: Pagination page number (1-based index). Always required by all endpoints utilizing this DTO.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per result page. Always required; default typically 20, up to maximum 100 depending on business/global configuration.

IShoppingMallReviewStatusHistory.description:
Represents a single immutable moderation, withdrawal, or status change event for a product review in a shopping mall platform.

This schema is based on the append-only shopping_mall_review_status_histories table. Each entry is a non-editable, non-deletable, audit-grade event providing full traceability of all status/mode changes (publication, rejection, flagging, withdrawal, deletion, etc.) across the review's lifecycle. It supports regulatory, compliance, and dispute-resolution auditing by maintaining an irrefutable historical log of every moderation/deletion/withdrawal with identity-level traceability to the specific actor and session responsible.

Entries reference multiple possible actor roles (customer, seller, admin) where the actor is represented by an optional foreign key. This enables auditability regardless of which platform actor performed the status change and supports edge cases (e.g., system-triggered events with null actor fields). This design ensures support for platform compliance, business policy audit, and forensic analysis use cases. Relationships are explicitly maintained for all possible acting entity types and sessions for robust, enterprise-grade trace logging.

id.description:
Primary key for this status/moderation history event.

This is a globally unique identifier for each status/moderation event, generated as a UUID. It provides immutable event identity supporting append-only and audit logging requirements for regulatory compliance. See shopping_mall_review_status_histories.id.

shopping_mall_review_id.description:
Identifier of the product review affected by this moderation/status event.

References shopping_mall_reviews.id, representing the review whose status this event modifies. Supports full historical trace of moderation on a per-review basis.

status.description:
Status value assigned as the result of this moderation event (e.g., created, published, rejected, flagged, withdrawn, deleted).

This value reflects the resultant workflow state assigned to the review after the event. The set of possible values is externally enumerated in the business requirements and includes every significant business state or moderation result in the review lifecycle.

reason.description:
Optional explanation or detailed justification for the status change, such as administrative reasoning, rejection rationale, customer withdrawal cause, policy violation message, or platform/system context.

Null if no explanation provided, event is trivial, or not applicable for audit context. Allows for flexible regulatory and workflow support.

created_at.description:
Timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC) when this status event was recorded.

Entry is immutable and chronologically ordered in the table. Maintains the sequence of audit events and supports time-based queries in audit/compliance workflows. See shopping_mall_review_status_histories.created_at.

actor_customer_id.description:
The UUID of the customer actor who performed this status event, if triggered by a customer action (e.g., a customer withdrawing their review).

References shopping_mall_customers.id. Null if event was performed by a seller, admin, or system. Use this to determine responsibility and forensics in customer-initiated moderation actions.

actor_seller_id.description:
The UUID of the seller actor who performed this status event, if triggered by a seller action (e.g., seller moderation or dispute response).

References shopping_mall_sellers.id. Null if event was performed by a customer, admin, or system.

actor_admin_id.description:
The UUID of the admin actor who performed this status event, if triggered by an administrative moderation action.

References shopping_mall_admins.id. Null if event was performed by a customer, seller, or system.

actor_session_id.description:
The session ID (UUID) in which the status event was performed, captured for full auditability and compliance assurance if available. Session may reference any session record corresponding to the actual actor type (e.g., shopping_mall_admin_sessions.id, seller session, or customer session) depending on who performed the event.

Supports traceability and analysis of security context. Null if not relevant or unavailable for system/automated operations.

IShoppingMallAdminActionLog.IRequest.description:
Query filter, sorting, and pagination configuration for searching admin action logs.

Used to specify filters such as action type(s), responsible admin, date range, and contains parameters for pagination and sorting.

Intended for use by platform administrators and compliance auditors to efficiently search for relevant privileged actions in large datasets. This enables review for security, dispute resolution, and audit compliance.

All filters are optional and can be combined. Pagination and sorting fields control the size and order of returned log summaries in the listing operation.

Only accessible to authorized admin actors due to the sensitivity of audit log data. Invalid filter combinations or unauthorized access are rejected by the backend.

References to related schemas: IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary (for admin filter context).

admin_id.description: Restricts search results to action logs performed by a specific admin actor. UUID referencing shopping_mall_admins.id. Optional: If not set, no admin filter is applied.

action_type.description: Restricts results to a specific admin action type/category (e.g., 'user_suspend', 'role_escalate', 'order_refund'). Optional: If not set, returns logs of all types.

from.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for log creation date in UTC (ISO 8601). Filters for logs created at or after this datetime. Optional; omitted for open start of window.

to.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for log creation date in UTC (ISO 8601). Filters for logs created before this datetime. Optional; omitted for open end of window.

search.description: Case-insensitive search query to match within action_type or context_info. Optional field, supports substring match.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort results. Accepts only 'created_at' or 'action_type'. Defaults to 'created_at' if not set.
Field by which to sort results. Accepts only 'created_at' or 'action_type'. Defaults to 'created_at' if not set.

sort_by.description: Field by which to sort results. Accepts only 'created_at' or 'action_type'. Defaults to 'created_at' if not set.

oneOf.description: Sorting direction. Accepts 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first). Defaults to 'desc'.
Sorting direction. Accepts 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first). Defaults to 'desc'.

sort_dir.description: Sorting direction. Accepts 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first). Defaults to 'desc'.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Determines which page of results is returned. Must be >= 1. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of records per page. Allowed values: 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

IShoppingMallAdminActionLog.description:
Full admin action log record representing any privileged, sensitive, or system-level operation performed by a platform administrator in the shopping mall backend.

Provides a complete immutable audit trail of all privilege elevation, user moderation, order overrides, dispute management, configuration changes, and security interventions. Acts as a central source of truth for compliance audits, security reviews, and dispute forensics.

Each entry explicitly ties the responsible admin (shopping_mall_admin_id), action type (categorical), contextual details (context_info), timestamp, and all relevant entity references. Timestamps are stored in UTC and follow ISO 8601.

Sensitive and traceable; only administrators with proper authorization have visibility into these records. Supports cross-auditing and linkage to other platform entities for forensic investigation. Description properties are detailed per corresponding Prisma schema field.

id.description: Unique identifier for the admin action log. Primary key; corresponds to shopping_mall_admin_action_logs.id. Immutable and used for single record retrieval or cross-entity linkage.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Admin actor responsible for this action. Foreign key to shopping_mall_admins.id. Used for compliance attribution and role-based audit tracing.

action_type.description: The categorical type of admin action performed. Provides grouping (e.g., user_suspend, role_escalate, order_refund, config_change) for structured analysis and reporting.

oneOf.description: Optional JSON-encoded or text data providing additional context—such as the target entity state, request/response payload, or specific operation parameters—at time of action.
Field is omitted or not applicable when action does not require extra context.

context_info.description: Optional field for storing additional details associated with the action (JSON/text).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the admin action was performed (UTC, ISO 8601). Immutable, precise to milliseconds.

status.description: Filter for escalation queues by current workflow status (e.g., open, investigating, closed, resolved, rejected, etc.). Only records with the specified status will be included in the search results. Optional. Must match allowed statuses in escalation workflow.

priority.description: Filter for escalation queues by priority classification for triage (e.g., low, normal, high, urgent, critical). Optional. Only records with the given priority will be included.

escalation_type.description: Filter for business escalation category (e.g., refund_dispute, policy_violation, compliance_check, complaint, delivery_exception). Optional. Only escalation cases of the specified business type will be included.

assigned_admin_id.description: Filter for records assigned to a specific admin by their unique UUID. If present, restricts results to only those assigned to this admin actor.

initiator_actor_admin_id.description: Filter for escalation cases where the initiator actor was an admin with this UUID. Optional.

initiator_actor_seller_id.description: Filter for escalation cases where the initiator actor was a seller with this UUID. Optional.

initiator_actor_customer_id.description: Filter for escalation cases where the initiator actor was a customer with this UUID. Optional.

created_from.description: Filter for escalation cases created at or after this UTC timestamp. Optional.

created_to.description: Filter for escalation cases created before or at this UTC timestamp. Optional.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Must be >= 1. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description: Number of results per page for pagination. Sensible upper bound recommended (e.g., 10–100). Defaults to 25 if not specified.

sort_by.description: Sort field for results, such as created_at, priority, or status. Must match allowed sortable fields. Optional.

oneOf.description: Direction for sorting the result set. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Optional. Defaults to 'desc'.
Direction for sorting the result set. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Optional. Defaults to 'desc'.

sort_direction.description: Direction for sorting the result set. Must be either 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Optional. Defaults to 'desc'.

IShoppingMallEscalationQueue.IRequest.description: DTO for searching and filtering escalation queue records in the shopping mall platform. Includes support for status, priority, escalation type, assignment, actor, creation time, pagination, and sorting. Use in PATCH /shoppingMall/admin/escalationQueues for admins to query unresolved or triaged business events. Flexible filtering enables operational workflow, triage, and platform compliance management.

id.description: Unique primary key for the escalation queue record.

escalation_type.description: Business category for the escalation event (e.g., refund_dispute, policy_violation, compliance_check, complaint, delivery_exception). Required at creation.

reason_detail.description: Detailed business justification or contextual explanation for why the event is escalated. Required at creation.

status.description: Current workflow status for this escalation event (e.g., open, investigating, resolved, closed, rejected, admin_pending, compliance_review). Required and updated as the workflow proceeds.

priority.description: Operational triage and escalation queue priority (low, normal, high, urgent, critical). Used for sorting and rapid workflow assignment.

initiator_actor_admin_id.description: UUID of the admin actor who initiated this escalation event (if applicable). Nullable if initiated by other actors.

initiator_actor_seller_id.description: UUID of the seller actor who initiated this escalation event (if applicable). Nullable if not initiated by a seller.

initiator_actor_customer_id.description: UUID of the customer actor who initiated this escalation event (if applicable). Nullable if not initiated by a customer.

assigned_admin_id.description: UUID of the admin who is assigned to handle this escalation event (if assignment has occurred in workflow). Nullable if unassigned.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this escalation queue record was created (UTC, ISO 8601).

resolved_at.description: Timestamp when the escalation event was resolved or closed (nullable until resolution).

last_updated_at.description: Most recent update timestamp for this escalation queue event (UTC, ISO 8601).

IShoppingMallEscalationQueue.description:
Business escalation or dispute event requiring human/admin intervention, advanced workflow routing, or compliance-driven audit within the shopping mall platform.

Represents an unresolved, exceptional, or in-process event (from refund disputes, seller complaints, customer incidents, policy violations, or major workflow exceptions) that requires structured review as part of operational management, compliance investigation, or dispute resolution.

Fields capture initiating actor UUIDs and assignments (all as optional IDs), business domain category, workflow status, assigned admin, resolution metadata, audit/compliance timestamps, and operational priority. Serves as the operational record for all escalations requiring intervention, enabling search, workflow management, and detailed audit for platform risk and quality control processes.

IShoppingMallEscalationQueue.ICreate.description:
DTO for creating a new escalation record in the shopping mall escalation queue system.

Captures all required input fields for initiating an escalation event due to unresolved business issues, disputes, or exceptions. All fields present in the underlying schema required at creation (such as escalation type, actor, status, priority, and detailed reason) are expressed for comprehensive audit and workflow onboarding. Assignment of admins and resolution timestamps are managed by subsequent updates. Actor fields are mutually exclusive: only one should be populated depending on which type of actor initiates the escalation. This structure ensures the correct tracking and compliance routing for every escalation event at the point of creation.

escalation_type.description: Business category for escalation (e.g., refund_dispute, policy_violation, compliance_check, complaint, delivery_exception). This must match one of the escalation types handled by platform workflows.

reason_detail.description: Detailed explanation of why the event is escalated. Includes relevant business/process context explaining the escalation's necessity.

status.description: Initial state of the escalation (e.g., open, investigating, admin_pending). Must be a valid workflow status for this entity. Typically a value such as 'open' is used at creation.

priority.description: Priority classification for triage (e.g., low, normal, high, urgent, critical).

initiator_actor_admin_id.description: ID of admin actor initiating the escalation. Nullable/optional; only set if the escalation is started by an admin actor.

initiator_actor_seller_id.description: ID of seller actor initiating the escalation. Nullable/optional; only set if escalation is started by a seller.

initiator_actor_customer_id.description: ID of customer actor initiating escalation. Nullable/optional; only set if escalation is initiated by a customer.

IShoppingMallEscalationQueue.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating an existing escalation record. Used by workflow managers and admins to track investigation progress, reassign responsibility, update status/priority, modify business context, or complete the record.

You may update assignment, status, priority, detailed reason, and resolution timestamp. Assignment (assigned_admin_id) is set by workflow managers/admins, not at initial creation. Do not include immutable identifiers or creation timestamp fields. Partial updates are permitted; all fields are optional, but at least one should be provided per operation. Updates are logged and subject to compliance auditing.

escalation_type.description: [Optional] Update the escalation category. Must be among valid platform escalation types.

reason_detail.description: [Optional] Update or clarify the detailed reason for the escalation.

status.description: [Optional] Change the workflow status (e.g., investigating, resolved, closed, rejected, admin_pending, compliance_review).

assigned_admin_id.description: [Optional] Assign or reassign the admin responsible for managing this escalation. Set to null to remove assignment.

resolved_at.description: [Optional] Resolution/completion timestamp. ISO8601 datetime (UTC). Set when the escalation is resolved; null otherwise.

IShoppingMallAuditLog.IRequest.description:
Filtering and pagination criteria for searching audit log entries in the shopping mall platform audit log. 

Supports complex queries by change type, actor, risk level, compliance tag, and time range. Enables administrators to efficiently locate compliance-critical or security-relevant events for review. 

Typically used by privileged admin actors for incident response, compliance audits, and system activity investigations. Pagination and sorting are included for scalable result retrieval.

All fields are optional to allow flexible searching, but specific queries may improve performance. Absent criteria result in a broad search.

change_type.description: Nature of the audited event to filter for (e.g., access, update, delete, permission_change, data_export). Optional filter; supports fuzzy or exact matching according to backend rules.

risk_level.description: Filter results by risk classification (e.g., low, medium, high, critical). Optional; if not specified, all risk levels are matched.

compliance_tag.description: Filter by compliance or business rule tag (e.g., GDPR_ARTICLE5, PCI_LOG, SOX_ACCESS). Optional; for audit trail enforcement matching.

actor_admin_id.description: Admin actor UUID to filter for only entries performed by this administrator. Optional; only matches audit logs where this admin is the responsible actor.

actor_seller_id.description: Seller actor UUID pointer to restrict results to events performed by this seller. Optional filter; only matches logs where this seller was the responsible actor.

actor_customer_id.description: Customer UUID pointer to restrict results to audit events where this customer is the actor. Optional; only matches logs with customer as responsible actor.

start_time.description: Filter for audit logs created on or after this date-time (inclusive). Should use ISO 8601 format, e.g., "2025-11-15T00:00:00+09:00". Used for time-range filtering.

end_time.description: Filter for audit logs created before or on this date-time (inclusive). Should use ISO 8601 format. Used for time-range/pagination filtering.

search.description: General full-text search or keyword input, supports "contains" searches against audit_detail or metadata fields, according to backend implementation.

page.description: Page number for paginated result sets. 1-based by default; omitted or set to 1 for first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Typically defaults to 20 or 50, maximum is 100.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort results. Only specific fields allowed (created_at, risk_level, change_type).
Field by which to sort results. Only specific fields allowed (created_at, risk_level, change_type).
Field by which to sort results. Only specific fields allowed (created_at, risk_level, change_type).

sort_by.description: Field by which to sort results. Only specific fields allowed (created_at, risk_level, change_type).

oneOf.description: Sort direction, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc).
Sort direction, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

sort_direction.description: Sort direction, either ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

IShoppingMallAuditLog.description:
Single audit log entry from the shopping mall's central audit log table, capturing compliance, security-critical, or privileged operational events.

Each audit log entry records the actor responsible (admin, seller, customer, or system automation), the type and risk classification of the event, compliance tag justifying the log, and detailed contextual information relevant to the change or action. A cryptographic timestamp ensures event durability and traceability for regulatory and incident response requirements.

Used for read-only purposes in admin/compliance dashboards, regulatory reviews, and security investigations. This type exposes all non-sensitive audit log attributes for review and search purposes.

Maps directly to Prisma model shopping_mall_audit_logs.

id.description: Primary key for the audit log entry, corresponds to shopping_mall_audit_logs.id.

change_type.description: Nature/type of the audited event or change, such as access, update, delete, permission_change, or data_export. Matches field in Prisma: shopping_mall_audit_logs.change_type.

risk_level.description: Risk classification as per business/compliance rules, such as low, medium, high, critical. Prisma field: shopping_mall_audit_logs.risk_level.

compliance_tag.description: Compliance rule, policy, or business justification identifier for the log entry (e.g., GDPR_ARTICLE5, PCI_LOG). Prisma field: shopping_mall_audit_logs.compliance_tag.

audit_detail.description: Detailed contextual information about the audited event. May include JSON string or plain text depending on log. Prisma field: shopping_mall_audit_logs.audit_detail.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the audit event occurred, in ISO 8601 format for audit compliance. Prisma field: shopping_mall_audit_logs.created_at.

actor_admin_id.description: UUID reference to admin actor responsible, or null if not applicable (automated/system action or other actor). Prisma field: shopping_mall_audit_logs.actor_admin_id.

actor_seller_id.description: UUID reference to seller actor, or null if not applicable. Prisma field: shopping_mall_audit_logs.actor_seller_id.

actor_customer_id.description: UUID reference to customer actor, or null if not applicable. Prisma field: shopping_mall_audit_logs.actor_customer_id.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.IRequest.description:
Search and filter parameters for refund request queries in the shopping mall platform. This DTO enables advanced searching and pagination over refund request records for admin dashboards, workflow management, and compliance audits.

Allows filtering by status, actor (customer, seller, admin), time ranges, amount ranges, and textual reason. Pagination and ordering controls support efficient navigation of large datasets. Each property matches a business requirement or index used for query optimization.

Used primarily by admin or compliance actors; access should be restricted to authorized roles.

status.description: Refund request status to filter by. Permitted values correspond to internal workflow states such as pending, approved, rejected, processing, refunded, cancelled.

customer_id.description: Customer UUID to filter refund requests by actor. Used by admin to review a specific customer's requests.

seller_id.description: Seller UUID to filter refund requests by transaction party. Enables review of refund requests impacting a particular seller.

admin_id.description: Admin UUID to filter refund requests by processing/approval actor. Useful for audit trails and workflow assignment reviews.

order_id.description: Order UUID to restrict results to refund requests related to a specific order.

reason.description: Text search or exact match for the refund reason submitted by the customer. Use for content moderation, keyword filtering, or investigation.

created_from.description: Inclusive UTC datetime lower bound for refund request creation. Enables time-windowed analytics or SLA checks.

created_to.description: Inclusive UTC datetime upper bound for refund request creation.

updated_from.description: UTC datetime filter for last modification. Used for retrieving recently updated records.

updated_to.description: UTC datetime filter for last modification, upper bound.

requested_amount_min.description: Minimum requested refund amount for filter query. Used to find high-value or threshold-eligible requests.

requested_amount_max.description: Maximum requested refund amount for filter query.

approved_amount_min.description: Minimum approved refund amount for analytics, compliance, or threshold review.

approved_amount_max.description: Maximum approved refund amount for analytics, compliance, or threshold review.

page.description: Pagination control: page number (1-based). Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Pagination control: maximum number of items per page; system may cap this value.

sort_by.description: Order results by a specific field (e.g., created_at, updated_at, status, amount). Platform should document supported values.

oneOf.description: Sort direction, must be either 'asc' or 'desc'. Value enforcement is required.
Sort direction, must be either 'asc' or 'desc'. Value enforcement is required.

sort_order.description: Sort direction, must be either 'asc' or 'desc'. Value enforcement is required.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.description:
Main response entity for customer-initiated refund requests in the shopping mall platform. Represents all auditable, workflow-relevant fields as modeled in the database schema.

Each field matches a business process, compliance policy, or critical workflow. Actor references are represented as referenced object types for customer, seller, and admin for detail views. Used in order management, customer support, and refund workflow automation.

Returned by all detail, update, and create API operations for refund requests.

id.description: Primary key and unique identifier of the refund request. Used as the index for all workflow and platform references.

order.description: Order summary representing the transaction associated with the refund request. Populated from shopping_mall_orders.

customer.description: Customer summary, the originator of the refund request. Populated from shopping_mall_customers.

seller.description: Seller summary, the transaction party in dispute. Populated from shopping_mall_sellers.

admin.description: Admin summary assigned or involved in workflow processing. Nullable if unassigned.

status.description: Current status of the refund request (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, processing, refunded). Defines workflow state in business logic.

reason.description: Customer-submitted reason for the refund request. Required, used for workflow, audit, and compliance.

requested_amount.description: Amount of money the customer requested to be refunded. Always required at submission.

approved_amount.description: Amount of money approved for refund, after review by admin or seller. Nullable until approved/decided.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the refund request was created (UTC ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: Datetime of the most recent update to the refund request. Used for SLA, workflow management, and audit.

deleted_at.description: Datetime when refund request was soft deleted, or null if still active. Used for compliance and regulatory audit.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Foreign key linking refund request to the affected order. The value must be an existing order ID. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}

reason.description: Customer's reason for refund request, provided at submission.

requested_amount.description: Monetary amount requested for refund by the customer.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Seller responsible for the transaction. This must be the UUID of the seller involved in the order. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.ICreate.description:
Data required for a customer to create a new refund request for an order or order item in the shopping mall platform.

This DTO collects the order reference, seller association, reason for the refund, and requested refund amount. It excludes the customer/user ID (injected from auth context), as well as admin and workflow‐specific fields. On creation, the status is always set to 'pending'. All referenced UUIDs must be valid and correspond to existing records.

This request initiates a formal refund process and triggers all subsequent platform workflows for review, compliance, and resolution.

status.description: Current status of the refund request (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, processing, refunded). Only mutable through this DTO as part of workflow.

approved_amount.description: Amount approved for refund as decided by admin/seller after review. Nullable until decision is made. Only settable by authorized actors.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Admin involved in processing or making a decision for this refund request, if assigning/reassigning. Nullable field.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating allowed details of an existing refund request in the shopping mall platform.

Permits workflow‐allowed fields to be changed: status (state transitions), approved_amount, and optionally assignment or reassignment of an admin handler. All changes are fully audited and only possible by authorized actors (primarily admins). Immutable fields (requested_amount, associations) are not included and cannot be changed after creation.

status.description: Status of disputes to filter by (e.g., open, investigating, resolved, rejected, escalated, closed). Optional. Multiple selection not supported in single request; filter for one status or omit for all statuses.

customer_id.description: UUID of the customer actor. Filter disputes involving this customer.

seller_id.description: UUID of the seller actor. Filter disputes involving this seller.

admin_id.description: UUID of the admin in charge. Filter disputes assigned to this admin.

refund_request_id.description: Filter for disputes linked to a specific refund request.

subject.description: Keyword search in the subject line of the dispute.

root_cause.description: Keyword search in the root cause field.

created_from.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp to filter disputes created from (inclusive).

created_to.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp to filter disputes created to (inclusive).

oneOf.description: Column to order results by. One of: created_at, updated_at, status.
Column to order results by. One of: created_at, updated_at, status.
Column to order results by. One of: created_at, updated_at, status.

order_by.description: Column to order results by. One of: created_at, updated_at, status.

oneOf.description: Sort order: asc (ascending) or desc (descending).
Sort order: asc (ascending) or desc (descending).

order.description: Sort order: asc (ascending) or desc (descending).

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Starts at 1.

limit.description: Number of records per page.

IShoppingMallDispute.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching, filtering, and paginating platform dispute cases.

Allows filtering by status, actors (customer/seller/admin), date ranges, keywords, and linked refund request. Supports ordering and pagination. Enables efficient search for dispute resolution workflows and platform compliance audits.

id.description: Unique identifier of the dispute case.

refund_request.description: Original refund request linked to this dispute, if any. Nullable if not created from a refund request.

admin.description: Admin handling or mediating the dispute. Nullable until assigned or if not handled by staff yet.

status.description: Current status of the dispute (open, investigating, resolved, rejected, escalated, closed).

subject.description: Business-driven subject description (e.g., 'Non-delivery', 'Item not as described').

root_cause.description: Primary cause or summary leading to the dispute, assessed by actors or admin.

resolution_note.description: Final resolution decision, note, or verdict by the admin. Nullable until a decision is made.

created_at.description: Datetime the dispute was created in UTC (RFC3339 format).

updated_at.description: Last update datetime (RFC3339 format).

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Null if not deleted.

IShoppingMallDispute.description:
Dispute case for the shopping mall platform.

Tracks customer, seller, admin actors, refund request origin, current status, business subject, root cause, resolution note, and all supporting context for investigation, audit, and compliance. Reflects the complete lifecycle and state of the dispute record for platform governance and workflow management.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.ISummary.description:
Summary of a customer-initiated refund request for an order or item, surfaced for list views and quick review.

Focuses on the workflow, actors, amounts, state, and visibility for soft-deleted items. Appropriate for dashboards where status, reason, and timestamps are more important than full request/response history or regulatory/audit details.

Combines business-critical fields and summary reference objects for operational overviews and N+1-safe list display.

id.description: Primary key for the refund request entity.

order.description: Summary object of the order for contextually connecting to the parent order in the UI. Prevents need for separate /orders API calls.

customer.description: Summary object (context) for the customer who made the refund request, used in queues and dashboards.

seller.description: Summary object for the seller responsible for this order/refund. Enables contextual business process display.

status.description: Current life-cycle status: pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, processing, refunded. Matches workflow and compliance states.

reason.description: User-provided reason for the refund request. Used for triage and business review.

requested_amount.description: Amount requested by customer. Used for dashboard display and review.

oneOf.description: Approved refund amount if available.
Null if no decision yet.

approved_amount.description: Amount ultimately approved for refund; can be null if not yet decided.

created_at.description: When this refund request was created.

updated_at.description: Last workflow state change or modification time.

oneOf.description: Timestamp for soft-deletion if logically deleted.
Null if refund request has not been soft-deleted.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp; null if not deleted. Enables API consumers to handle invisible/archived rows in summary list operations.

IShoppingMallDispute.ICreate.description:
Create DTO for a new dispute case in the shopping mall platform dispute management module.

All references to other actors/entities match database relationships and allow for nullability during creation. Optional actor/admin fields can be omitted or set to null at creation; they are only required if business logic dictates (e.g., if linking to a refund request or assigning admin on creation). All nullable attributes marked as oneOf [value, null] and clarified in description for precise frontend and backend contract.

Includes references to any related refund request, required actor roles, dispute status/workflow state, and business-driven subject/causation information. Validates both workflow compliance and traceability for governance. At creation, shopping_mall_admin_id and resolution_note may be set to null or omitted.

oneOf.description: Original refund request linked to this dispute, if applicable. Nullable. Refers to shopping_mall_refund_requests.id. Required if the dispute is about a specific refund request.
Null if no refund request is linked to this dispute.

shopping_mall_refund_request_id.description: Nullable reference to a refund request. Null for general disputes or cases not directly stemming from a refund request. Frontends may omit or set null on creation if not applicable.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Customer involved in the dispute. Refers to shopping_mall_customers.id. Required to identify the originator or subject.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Seller involved in the dispute. Refers to shopping_mall_sellers.id. Required for seller/shop context.

oneOf.description: Admin handling or mediating the dispute at creation (if pre-assigned).
Null if not yet assigned or admin actor not determined at creation.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Nullable admin reference; may be omitted/null when dispute is first logged by customer or system.

status.description: Dispute status: open, investigating, resolved, rejected, escalated, closed. Must be a valid workflow status at creation.

subject.description: Short, business-driven description of the dispute's subject (e.g., 'Non-delivery', 'Item not as described'). Provide a brief, user-facing summary.

root_cause.description: Primary cause or issue leading to the dispute, as assessed by actors or admin. Should capture the main business or platform problem.

oneOf.description: Final resolution details/decision note at creation.
Null if decision not yet recorded at creation.

resolution_note.description: Final resolution details or decision note from admin. Nullable until decision. Can be set to null or omitted at creation.

shopping_mall_refund_request_id.description: Updated refund request linked to the dispute, if applicable. Nullable. Refers to shopping_mall_refund_requests.id.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Updated customer involved in the dispute. Usually immutable in workflow; only set if business logic allows actor reassignment.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Updated seller involved in the dispute. Rarely changed, but included for completeness.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Admin handling or mediating the dispute. Can be assigned or reassigned as workflow transitions.

status.description: Update to the dispute's workflow status. Valid status required: open, investigating, resolved, rejected, escalated, closed.

subject.description: Updated subject of the dispute. Used to capture refined or corrected summary.

root_cause.description: Update the primary business or platform cause leading to the dispute.

resolution_note.description: Admin's resolution or final decision note. Nullable. Can be updated as decision progresses.

IShoppingMallDispute.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for existing dispute cases in the shopping mall platform. All fields are optional; sets new values to the indicated properties as workflow, assignment, or resolution progresses. Follows audit and compliance traceability. Typical usage assigns admin, changes status, or records resolution. No required fields, but must submit at least one mutable field.

IShoppingMallDisputeHistory.description:
Represents a single snapshot event in the lifetime workflow of a dispute. Each record functions as an immutable audit log detailing a change in status, an actor's administrative/customer/seller action, timestamp, and any context note.

Used for forensic, compliance, and workflow traceability during dispute resolution. Supports roles: admin, seller, or customer as action sources. Linked to its parent dispute and involved actors when relevant (else fields are null to indicate not involved in this historical record).

Provides the historical foundation for compliance, retrospective analysis, and advanced incident review throughout the shopping mall's dispute management lifecycle.

id.description: Primary key for this historical snapshot event. Universally unique identifier (UUID).

shopping_mall_dispute_id.description: Dispute associated with this historical snapshot. References shopping_mall_disputes.id.

status.description: Status of the dispute at this event in its history. Encodes workflow position or state (open, escalated, resolved, etc).

note.description: Optional contextual note or reasoning attached to this status/event. Can be null if no note is present.

shopping_mall_actor_admin_id.description: Admin responsible for this action; UUID if admin actor performed this event, else null.

shopping_mall_actor_customer_id.description: Customer responsible for this action; UUID if customer actor performed this event, else null.

shopping_mall_actor_seller_id.description: Seller responsible for this action; UUID if seller actor performed this event, else null.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this history log entry was created (ISO 8601).

IShoppingMallDisputeHistory.IRequest.description:
Parameters for paginated and optionally filtered dispute history retrieval.

Supports dispute history review with customizable paging, sorting, and search filter for incident review by admin user. Used as the request body for retrieving a paginated set of historical dispute actions for compliance auditing and workflow analysis.

Admins can filter histories by status or actor, and control pagination for efficient data browsing.

page.description: Page number of result set. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of dispute history records to return per page. Defaults and max 100.

status.description: Optional: filter results to histories matching a specific dispute status. Null or omitted to disable filtering.

actor_admin_id.description: Optional: filter results to histories performed by a specific admin actor (UUID). Null or omitted to disable filter.

actor_customer_id.description: Optional: filter results to those performed by a specific customer (UUID). Null or omitted to disable filter.

actor_seller_id.description: Optional: filter results to those performed by a specific seller (UUID). Null or omitted to disable filter.

IShoppingMallDisputeMessage.description:
Represents a direct message exchanged between dispute participants (customer, seller, admin) within a specific dispute context in the shopping mall platform.

Each message documents structured communication as part of an official dispute thread, supporting traceability, audit, and compliance for platform conflict resolution.

Parent dispute linkage is reported as shopping_mall_dispute_id (UUID). All actor references (sender/receiver for admin, seller, customer) are represented as `.ISummary` objects, not UUIDs. This eliminates N+1 reads and ensures atomic API responses. Supports soft-deletion via deleted_at timestamp for compliance and privacy.

id.description:
Primary identifier for this dispute message.

Auto-generated UUID referencing the unique row in the shopping_mall_dispute_messages table.

shopping_mall_dispute_id.description: Foreign key to the parent dispute in which this message was posted. Links to shopping_mall_disputes.id. Enforces thread context for the message and ties it to the relevant dispute record.

sender_admin.description: Sender admin actor who sent this message (if applicable). Returns .ISummary object for atomic response. Null if not sent by admin.

sender_seller.description: Sender seller actor who sent this message (if applicable). Returns .ISummary object. Null if not sent by seller.

sender_customer.description: Sender customer actor who sent this message (if applicable). Returns .ISummary object. Null if not sent by customer.

receiver_admin.description: Receiver admin actor (if applicable). Returns .ISummary object. Null if receiver is not admin.

receiver_seller.description: Receiver seller actor (if applicable). Returns .ISummary object. Null if receiver is not seller.

receiver_customer.description: Receiver customer actor (if applicable). Returns .ISummary object. Null if receiver is not customer.

role.description: Role of the sender within the dispute thread. Indicates if the sender is acting as 'admin', 'seller', or 'customer'. Used for display, filtering, and compliance validation.

content.description: Main text body of the message as exchanged within the dispute resolution process. Subject to compliance checks, GIN-index search, and editorial policies. Not null.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this message was officially recorded in the platform dispute context.

Used for chronological sorting and audit trails.

oneOf.description: Timestamp marking when this message was soft-deleted (logically erased) for privacy or compliance.
Message is active and not deleted.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. Present only if the message has been logically deleted. If null, message is visible to dispute participants and part of the live audit.

IShoppingMallDisputeMessage.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, and pagination parameters for querying message records within a given dispute case.

Allows filtering by sender/receiver identity, message content, role (admin/seller/customer), and supports full-text search, sort options, and page controls. Used by UI and compliance systems to efficiently locate or review communication history for dispute resolution and audit trace.

oneOf.description: Filter for messages sent by a specific admin actor.
Not filtering by admin sender.

sender_admin_id.description: If specified, restrict results to messages sent by a given admin. Nullable for unconstrained queries.

oneOf.description: Filter for messages sent by a specific seller actor.
Not filtering by seller sender.

sender_seller_id.description: If specified, restrict results to messages sent by a given seller. Nullable for unconstrained queries.

oneOf.description: Filter for messages sent by a specific customer actor.
Not filtering by customer sender.

sender_customer_id.description: If specified, restrict results to messages sent by a given customer. Nullable for unconstrained queries.

oneOf.description: Filter for messages received by a specific admin actor.
Not filtering by admin receiver.

receiver_admin_id.description: If specified, restrict results to messages received by a given admin. Nullable for unconstrained queries.

oneOf.description: Filter for messages received by a specific seller actor.
Not filtering by seller receiver.

receiver_seller_id.description: If specified, restrict results to messages received by a given seller. Nullable for unconstrained queries.

oneOf.description: Filter for messages received by a specific customer actor.
Not filtering by customer receiver.

receiver_customer_id.description: If specified, restrict results to messages received by a given customer. Nullable for unconstrained queries.

oneOf.description: Restrict results to a single sender role (one of 'admin', 'seller', 'customer').
Restrict results to a single sender role (one of 'admin', 'seller', 'customer').
Restrict results to a single sender role (one of 'admin', 'seller', 'customer').
Not filtering by sender role.

role.description: Sender role for filtered search queries. Cases-insensitive match against role values for compliant filtering. Null for no filter.

oneOf.description: Case-insensitive substring to search for within message content, GIN-indexed for full-text queries.
No keyword/content filter applied.

content_contains.description: Full-text search pattern for message body. Useful for finding specific terms or review keywords in conversation history records.

oneOf.description: Earliest timestamp (inclusive) for filter window. ISO 8601 date-time string.
No lower-bound date constraint.

created_at_from.description: Filter for messages created after this timestamp. Null for no lower-bound.

oneOf.description: Latest timestamp (inclusive) for filter window. ISO 8601 date-time string.
No upper-bound date constraint.

created_at_to.description: Filter for messages created before or at this timestamp. Null for open-ended ranges.

oneOf.description: Sort field; supports 'created_at' or 'role' sorting semantics only.
Sort field; supports 'created_at' or 'role' sorting semantics only.
Default sort order (by created_at descending).

sort_by.description: Field to use for sorting result set. If not specified, default sort will be by created_at most recent first.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction for the result set.
Sort order direction for the result set.
Default sort order direction (descending).

order.description: Sort order: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending. Null for default ordering.

oneOf.description: Page number for paginated results, 1-based index.
Use default page (first page) if not specified.

page.description: Page number to fetch, starting from 1 for the first page. Null means first page.

oneOf.description: Maximum records per page, up to 100.
Default page size if not specified.

limit.description: Page size for paginated queries; defaults to system policy if not set, max 100.

content.description: Body of the message as exchanged within the dispute. Required. This should capture the communication content for audit and compliance.

role.description: Role of sender (admin, seller, customer) for easy filtering. Should be set based on the sender's actor type and reflect the participant's actual role in the context of the dispute.

oneOf.description: Admin user receiving this message (nullable if another actor). Refers to shopping_mall_admins.id.
Value is null if the receiver is not an admin.

shopping_mall_receiver_admin_id.description: Admin user who receives this message. Provide only if the receiver is an admin actor. Set to null otherwise.

oneOf.description: Seller who receives this message (nullable if another actor). Refers to shopping_mall_sellers.id.
Value is null if the receiver is not a seller.

shopping_mall_receiver_seller_id.description: Seller who receives this message. Provide only if the receiver is a seller actor. Set to null otherwise.

oneOf.description: Customer who receives this message (nullable if another actor). Refers to shopping_mall_customers.id.
Value is null if the receiver is not a customer.

shopping_mall_receiver_customer_id.description: Customer who receives this message. Provide only if the receiver is a customer actor. Set to null otherwise.

oneOf.description: Admin user who sent this message (nullable if another actor). Refers to shopping_mall_admins.id.
Value is null if the sender is not an admin.

shopping_mall_sender_admin_id.description: Admin sender ID if the sender is an admin. Set this to null if another actor type is the sender.

oneOf.description: Seller who sent this message (nullable if another actor). Refers to shopping_mall_sellers.id.
Value is null if the sender is not a seller.

shopping_mall_sender_seller_id.description: Seller sender ID if the sender is a seller. Set this to null if another actor type is the sender.

oneOf.description: Customer who sent this message (nullable if another actor). Refers to shopping_mall_customers.id.
Value is null if the sender is not a customer.

shopping_mall_sender_customer_id.description: Customer sender ID if the sender is a customer. Set this to null if another actor type is the sender.

Used to register a shipment for an order item, including required references to the order, order item, and shipping partner, along with status and optional tracking or manifest fields. At least one actor must be attributed via admin or seller. Nullable fields support scenarios where tracking or label information is not immediately present at creation.

Comprehensive validation is enforced against referenced entities and business logic for status transitions. The resulting shipment will include all required identifiers and an audit trail for creator, event times, and workflow state.

status.description:
Updated shipment status. Must be one of: pending, ready, picked_up, in_transit, delivered, cancelled, returned.

If status is set to delivered, payload MUST set delivery_at (see delivery_at field); if status is set to cancelled, payload MUST set cancelled_at (see cancelled_at field).

All status transitions are validated by business rules. Permissible transitions:
- pending → ready | cancelled
- ready → picked_up | cancelled
- picked_up → in_transit | cancelled
- in_transit → delivered | cancelled | returned
- delivered → returned
- cancelled: terminal
- returned: terminal

IShoppingMallShipment.IUpdate.description:
Update input type for an existing shipment record in the shopping mall platform.

Allows partial modification of carrier tracking, status, label/manifest url, API codes, and delivery/cancellation timestamps. Business rules:
- If setting status to 'delivered', delivery_at MUST be provided.
- If setting status to 'cancelled', cancelled_at MUST be provided.
- Only one actor attribution is allowed: EITHER updated_by_admin_id OR updated_by_seller_id MAY be set, never both. Omitting both is permitted when update is system-initiated or does not attribute an actor.

Foreign key relationships (order, order_item, shipping_partner) are immutable after creation. Only business-updatable fields are allowed in this DTO. API will enforce all workflow/lifecycle rules for valid statuses.
