oneOf.description: New pickup address to use, if updating location details.
Unset or remove the pickup address.

pickup_address.description: New pickup address to use, or unset/removal.

oneOf.description: Updated scheduled pickup date/time (Asia/Seoul).
Unset or remove scheduled pickup.

scheduled_pickup_at.description: Updated scheduled pickup date/time (Asia/Seoul), or remove.

oneOf.description: Updated carrier tracking code or RMA.
Unset or remove the current tracking code value.

provider_tracking_code.description: Updated carrier tracking code or RMA.

oneOf.description: Updated shipping partner carrier assignment.
Unset/remove the shipping partner assignment.

IShoppingMallReturnRequest.IUpdate.description:
Input type for updating/modifying fields of an existing reverse logistics request (return, pickup) on the shopping mall platform.

Allows mutation of modifiable fields such as reason, status, pickup location, pickup time, shipping partner, and tracking code. Status transitions and updates are validated according to workflow business rules, and system-managed fields (created_by, requested_by, audit-trails) are never client-editable.

IShoppingMallConfiguration.ISummary.description:
Summary schema for a shopping mall configuration entry.

Provides primary identifying details, current status, and descriptive metadata for platform configuration parameters. Used in lists, summaries, and lookup results but omits sensitive or large-value fields.

Reflects the actual database model and validation rules of the shopping_mall_configurations table. All properties and metadata must strictly correspond to the underlying schema. Intended for lightweight administrative or system-facing API responses.

id.description: Unique identifier of the configuration entry. Primary key from shopping_mall_configurations table.

config_key.description: Unique configuration key name, used for lookup across the service and API. Namespaced by category or domain. Must be unique by database constraint.

status.description: Current operational status of this configuration. Typical values are 'active', 'inactive', or 'deprecated' to govern rollout, removal, or runtime gating.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what this configuration controls, its intended effect, and usage scenarios. Provided for admin and operator reference.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the configuration was created. Audit and traceability purpose.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update for this configuration entry.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp of soft deletion (if applicable). Null if not deleted. Used for logical removal without data loss.

IShoppingMallCategory.ISummary.description:
Summary schema for a shopping mall product/navigation category.

Includes all key fields from shopping_mall_categories minimally required for administration, search, or navigation reference displays. Audit and status fields help with list management, soft-delete logic, and category display tooling.

id.description: Unique identifier for the category. Primary key of shopping_mall_categories.

name.description: UI-facing, globally-unique display name of the category.

parent_id.description: UUID of the parent category if this is a child node. Null if root. Used for tree construction and navigation.

description.description: Long-form description of purpose and coverage for admin/merchandiser context. Provided by admins and visible for search/filter logic and navigation tooling.

status.description: Operational status of the category, such as 'active', 'inactive', or 'deprecated'. Used for programmatic filter or admin control.

sort_order.description: Display ordering index. Categories with lower values appear before those with higher values in UI and API consumers.

updated_at.description: Last admin/edit update. Indicates history of changes or when this taxonomy branch was last managed.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete for safe deactivation of this category, preserving audit trail.

IShoppingMallExternalPaymentProvider.ISu.description:
Summary schema for an external payment provider in the shopping mall platform.

Presents all key fields per shopping_mall_external_payment_providers minimally required by admin, search, or reference scenarios. Status and audit attributes help manage provider lifecycle, include compliance information, and support regulatory traceability.

id.description: Provider unique identifier. Primary key of shopping_mall_external_payment_providers.

name.description: Provider's display name shown to users. Unique for each provider.

provider_code.description: System integration key/code—unique for backend mapping and API orchestration.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of this provider—used to enable/disable and filter available payment providers in all commerce flows. Accepts values like 'active', 'inactive', 'deprecated'.

description.description: Legal/business context and integration notes for provider. Maintained by admins for clarity of purpose and compliance tracking.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp, recorded upon row initialization for audit trail integrity.

updated_at.description: Last modification date, used for admin change history and trigger-based integration updates.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp that marks logical removal for compliance/audit.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the seller session record.

Primary key for session entity and reference point for audit and security tracking.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description:
References the seller who owns this session.

This foreign key links the session to its parent seller account, allowing lookup of all sessions by seller and enforcing ownership constraints.

ip.description:
IP address from which the session was initiated.

Used for security monitoring, audit, and fraud detection.

href.description:
Source URL of the session creation event.

Recorded to track the point of access and origin for the session.

referrer.description:
Referrer URL at the time the login/session was created.

Used to understand context and navigation flow leading to session creation.

created_at.description:
Session creation timestamp in UTC.

Represents the exact moment when the session was first established.

oneOf.description:
Timestamp for session expiry in UTC, or null if still active.

A null value indicates an active session; otherwise, it marks when the session expired due to logout or timeout.

expired_at.description:
Session expiry timestamp or null if active.

Represents automatic logout or manually ended session. Used for compliance and security audits.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a seller's authenticated session.

Includes all audit and security-related metadata needed for platform compliance, traceability of access, and session lifecycle tracking.

This type omits sensitive tokens and focuses on session context. Nullability for expired_at allows distinction between active and ended sessions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the seller verification record. Corresponds to the primary key. Used to track KYC/business verification status for a seller over time.

status.description: The current verification status. Possible values include: pending, approved, rejected, under_review, needs_more_info, etc. This property reflects the business/compliance state and determines if the seller can list products.

oneOf.description: Documentation references or IDs for KYC/compliance documents submitted by the seller. May remain null during the initial request cycle or if no documentation is required.
Value is null if no compliance documentation is present at this stage.

compliance_documents.description: Documentation references or IDs for KYC/compliance documents submitted by the seller. May remain null during the initial request cycle or if no documentation is required.

oneOf.description: Administrative notes that explain the state, rejection, or further requirements. Provides actionable context for sellers and admins.
Value is null if there are no administrative notes or additional requirements yet.

reason.description: Administrative notes that explain the state, rejection, or further requirements. Provides actionable context for sellers and admins.

oneOf.description: Datetime when this record was reviewed/decisioned.
Value is null if the record has not yet been reviewed.

reviewed_at.description: Datetime when this record was reviewed/decisioned.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the verification record was created. Used for audit trail and workflow traceability.

seller.description: The seller entity currently under verification. References the seller account for which this verification is recorded.

oneOf.description: Value is null if the current verification record has not been reviewed or assigned to an admin yet.

reviewerAdmin.description: Admin entity who reviewed or processed this record, if any. May be null for records in pending or unreviewed states.

IShoppingMallSellerVerification.ISummary.description:
Summary data structure for a single seller verification and compliance/KYC audit.

Represents a seller verification workflow entry, including current status, compliance documentation, admin review state, and workflow metadata. Links each verification record to the underlying seller and reviewer admin accounts. All records are append-only for traceability.

id.description: Unique identifier for admin session. Primary key from the shopping_mall_admin_sessions table.

ip.description: Originating IP address for this admin session. Recorded at login for audit and geo-tracing.

href.description: Access URL at session start. Captures the initial dashboard or API login URL for session forensics.

referrer.description: Referrer URL when login occurred. Used for tracing authentication flow source.

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp. Indicates when session was established.

oneOf.description: Session expiration datetime if terminated, otherwise null.
Null if session is currently active and has not expired.

expired_at.description: Session expiration datetime, or null if still active.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.ISummary.description:
Summary view of an admin session in the shopping mall admin portal.

Represents a record of a single authentication session for a platform administrator, including metadata such as session creation, originating IP, and HTTP context.

Used for display in admin session lists and for audit trail summaries. Sensitive to compliance and security reviews.

id.description: Unique identifier for the escalation record. Primary key from the shopping_mall_role_escalations table.

target_role.description: Role requested by the escalator (e.g., customer, seller, admin). Captures the intended new privilege level.

status.description: Escalation status representing current processing state: e.g., pending, approved, rejected, under_review, or revoked.

oneOf.description: Optional notes, justification, or comments supplied by requester or admin.
Null if no reason was provided.

reason.description: Notes, justification, or admin comments for this role change request.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the role escalation request was created.

oneOf.description: Datetime when escalation was processed or decisioned (approved/rejected).
Null if escalation is still pending or unprocessed.

IShoppingMallRoleEscalation.ISummary.description:
Summary record for a role escalation request in the platform.

Tracks an individual privilege or status escalation, including the type of role requested and its review status for audit and compliance purposes.

Used mainly for listing recent escalations and quick status review throughout admin oversight and user-facing history.

IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a shopping mall product for list or reference views.

Provides essential fields such as unique product ID, name, status, and default price for display in product lists, search results, or as reference context for related entities. Omits large text fields and composition arrays for performance and efficient data transfer. Ownership is indicated via the seller reference, which must use ISummary pattern. Category summaries are included for immediate classification context.

All fields derive from the shopping_mall_products table and required relationships. This type is intended for use in product summaries and compact result listings, not as a full detail view.

id.description:
Unique product identifier (UUID).

Primary key of the shopping_mall_products table. Used for internal references and as the basis for navigation and product linking.

title.description:
Public product name for display in product lists, search, and reference views.

Sourced from the title column of shopping_mall_products. Uniqueness is scoped to the seller.

default_price.description:
Default display price for the product, used in overviews and summary listings.

This is NOT the actual price per variant/SKU; it is for initial display and may differ from selectable option prices.

business_status.description:
Product business status string.

Indicates workflow state: draft, published, archived, blocked, pending_approval, etc. Application logic uses this value to control catalog eligibility.

seller.description:
Owning seller for this product.

References a summary of the seller entity (IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary). Must provide context for display, such as seller name, rating, and identifier.

categories.description:
Product categories associated with this product for search, navigation, and display filters.

Each entry is a summary of a product category (IShoppingMallProductCategory.ISummary).

created_at.description:
Timestamp for product creation (UTC).

Records the moment the product was created for sorting, auditing, and filtering.

id.description:
Primary key, matching the id field in shopping_mall_product_images.

A unique identifier (UUID) for this product image record. Used as the canonical identifier for reference, update, or deletion.

cdn_uri.description:
CDN or publicly accessible URI for the image media (shopping_mall_product_images.cdn_uri).

A direct link to the asset for rendering, download, or sharing. Must be unique in the table and used in all gallery and thumbnail displays.

oneOf.description: Accessibility/text alternative for the image, as stored in shopping_mall_product_images.alt_text. Shown on error or load failure, and used by screen readers for accessibility.
No alt text provided.

alt_text.description: Accessibility alternative text for the image, mapped from shopping_mall_product_images.alt_text. Nullable for images without alternative content.

position.description:
Display position ordering for the image. Matches shopping_mall_product_images.position.

Used for UI sorting in image carousels/galleries. Lower values mean the image is displayed earlier in sequence. Uniqueness guaranteed per product/sku.

oneOf.description:
Internal system or business label attached to the asset (shopping_mall_product_images.label).

Used for grouping or context in administrative UI or business logic (not shown to end users).
No label provided.

label.description: Business or system label from shopping_mall_product_images.label. Used for internal organization; nullable.

oneOf.description: (Reference) Product that this image is associated with, as a .ISummary object. If present, this image represents a product-level asset not tied to a specific SKU.
Not attached as a product-level image.

product.description: Reference to the parent product. Null if not associated as a product-image. Mapped from shopping_mall_product_id, transformed via DTO pattern.

oneOf.description: (Reference) SKU that this image is associated with, as a .ISummary object. If present, this image is specific to a particular SKU variant.
Not attached as a SKU-level image.

sku.description: Reference to the related SKU. Null if not associated as a SKU-image. Mapped from shopping_mall_product_sku_id, transformed via DTO pattern.

created_at.description:
UTC timestamp for asset creation (shopping_mall_product_images.created_at).

Used for audit trail and display of image asset recency.

updated_at.description:
UTC timestamp for any update to the asset (shopping_mall_product_images.updated_at).

Reflects the last modification to any property of the record.

oneOf.description: Soft delete marker timestamp indicating archival or inactive status (shopping_mall_product_images.deleted_at).
Not deleted (asset is active).

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker field. Null if image is active; set to timestamp if archived or removed. Always nullable.

IShoppingMallProductImage.ISummary.description:
Summary information about an image or media asset associated with a product or SKU in the shopping mall catalog.

This DTO includes all required fields for UI display of product/SKU image galleries or lists, plus audit/timeline fields ('created_at', 'updated_at') and soft delete marker ('deleted_at') for full lifecycle traceability. Relationship fields ('product', 'sku') follow AutoBE DTO reference transformation convention. All identifiers are reference objects when contextually displayed.

id.description:
Primary key of the attribute, matching shopping_mall_product_attributes.id.

A unique identifier for this product attribute, used to reference and manage allowed variant structures for a given product.

product.description:
Reference to the product for which this attribute is used, as a .ISummary object, matching the foreign key shopping_mall_product_id.

Provides context for attribute display and relationship maintenance.

attribute_name.description:
Logical name for this attribute (shopping_mall_product_attributes.attribute_name).

Examples: color, size, material, etc. Used as a key in variant option pickers.

position.description:
Display order for attribute in the UI context (shopping_mall_product_attributes.position).

Lower values are displayed first in variant selectors/pickers. Used for easy configuration and consistent presentation.

created_at.description:
UTC timestamp for attribute creation (shopping_mall_product_attributes.created_at).

Enabled audit trail and attribute management interfaces to display lifecycle history of variant structures.

updated_at.description:
UTC timestamp for last update of the attribute (shopping_mall_product_attributes.updated_at).

Reflects the most recent edit or change to this variant configuration.

deleted_at.description:
Soft delete marker, matching shopping_mall_product_attributes.deleted_at.

Null if attribute is active; set to timestamp when removed or hidden for safe deactivation.

IShoppingMallProductAttribute.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for a product attribute as used in the catalog's variant construction system.

Every field is included to match both product and audit/lifecycle requirements as defined in the shopping_mall_product_attributes Prisma model. The 'deleted_at' field is nullable to honor the soft-delete workflow. Descriptions clarify the business meaning, field origins, and usage context per AutoBE documentation guidance.

IShoppingMallProductAttributeValue.ISumm.description:
Summary DTO for product attribute value mapping to SKU.

Represents the individual value assigned to a single attribute for a given SKU in catalog variant construction. Used to support variant filtering, product option selection, and complete SKU specification. Includes value display name, audit fields, and full .ISummary references to both the SKU (sku) and the attribute (attribute) for context-driven usage.

id.description: Primary key of the mapping. Unique identifier for each attribute value record.

sku.description: The SKU instance for which this attribute value is defined. Provides .ISummary reference for context.

attribute.description: The corresponding attribute type for this value. Provides .ISummary reference for the attribute dictionary entry.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp for value mapping creation.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp for any value update.

IShoppingMallCart.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for a customer shopping cart.

Represents the state and identity of the customer's active cart, listing only essential data suitable for list views or lightweight embeddings. Used to provide high-level information regarding the cart, such as cart ID, customer, and update timestamps, but excludes detailed line item breakdowns. Each cart maps to exactly one customer. Lifecycle events (like checkout or deletion) result in this record transitioning out of summary listings. This schema links to the full cart entity and should be used whenever a lightweight representation of the cart is required, such as in cart summaries or order previews.

id.description: Unique identifier for this cart record. Automatically generated by the system.

customer.description: Linked customer (cart owner). Contains only summary info for list embedding. References {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

created_at.description: The UTC timestamp when this cart was created. Represents the beginning of the cart's lifecycle.

updated_at.description: Last time this cart was modified (item added, changed, or removed). Used for display order and recency filtering.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for a single item in the shopping cart.

Represents a single SKU and its desired quantity in a customer's cart, with a subset of information suitable for listing items/quantities without deep product or SKU expansion. This type should be used for in-cart item list displays and not for full detail or product composition. Each summary references the parent cart (by id, not object) and the underlying product SKU in summary form. Used heavily by UI to present quick overviews of the cart's current state.

id.description: Unique identifier for this cart item. System-generated at the time of record creation.

shopping_mall_cart_id.description: Reference to the parent shopping cart that owns this item. Matches {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

sku.description: Summary of the product SKU placed in the cart. Only summary information is included for efficient display and cross-linking.

quantity.description: Desired quantity of this SKU in the cart. Must be positive and less than or equal to the available inventory.

created_at.description: UTC time when this cart item was created. Marks when the product/variant was chosen.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this cart item record. Used for sorting and inventory refresh.

IShoppingMallWishlist.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a shopping mall persistent wishlist root entity, used in list endpoints and for association references.

Includes the identifier and creation timestamp, as well as the owning customer reference (IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary). Excludes detailed metadata and subsidiary records.

id.description: Primary key identifying the wishlist entity in the shopping_mall_wishlists table.

customer.description: Owning customer of the wishlist (association as summary object). Only summary customer information is included here.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the wishlist.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for wishlist items within a customer wishlist.

Represents a condensed view of a single wishlist item, indicating the associated SKU and the parent wishlist. Used in list or embedding contexts where full detail is unnecessary. Contains essential referencing context for rendering item lists, cross-module relationships, or data maintenance.

Key relationships: links to parent wishlist (summary), targeted SKU (usually another summary entity), supply only contextually relevant meta-information for performance; avoids expanding SKU/product details in full. Best for arrays and embedding.

Business context: Supports efficient rendering of wishlist contents for browsing, migration into cart flows, or display in aggregate customer lists.

id.description: Primary key of the wishlist item.

wishlist.description: Reference to the parent wishlist in summary form.

sku.description: Targeted SKU for this wishlist item (summary only).

created_at.description: Creation timestamp for this wishlist item.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a single item associated with a shopping mall order.

References product SKU in summary form (always IShoppingMallProductSku.ISummary for relational context), and omits direct product reference to avoid redundancy (product title is included in the SKU summary). Parent order is referenced by ID only (hierarchical context). All price, quantity, fulfillment, and aggregation fields are exposed for summary/to detail navigation, following normalized DTO best practices for list and embedding scenarios.

Business context: Designed for use in order detail summaries, fulfillment lists, and reports, allowing compact yet contextualized review of order contents.

id.description: Unique UUID of the order item. Primary key.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Parent order to which this item belongs. References shopping_mall_orders.id (hierarchical parent - ID only).

sku.description: Product SKU summary for this item (includes product information as embedded in SKU summary).

quantity.description: Number of units of this SKU ordered.

unit_price.description: Unit price at time of order for this SKU (discounts included, if any).

subtotal.description: Subtotal before order-level adjustments for this item (quantity × unit_price).

delivered.description: True if this item has been marked as delivered in fulfillment tracking.

refunded.description: True if this item has been refunded through returns/workflow.

created_at.description: Order item creation timestamp.

updated_at.description: Order item last update timestamp.

id.description: Unique identifier of this shipment. Corresponds to the primary key. Used to track shipment events and reference this shipment across related records or APIs.

order.description: Summary information of the order associated with this shipment. Replaces the raw UUID. Enables context and avoids N+1 query issues.

shipping_partner.description: Summary information of the shipping partner responsible for this shipment. Replaces the raw UUID for direct access to partner display info.

tracking_number.description: Shipping partner/tracking-provided unique tracking number for this shipment. This value is unique among all shipments for external tracking and customer notifications.

status.description: Shipment status indicator. One of: pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, returned. Indicates the current fulfillment or delivery state for this shipment batch.

oneOf.description: Date/time when the shipment was handed off to the logistics partner, in UTC. May be null if not yet shipped.
Null if not shipped.

ship_date.description: Date the shipment was handed to logistics partner; null if not yet shipped.

oneOf.description: The expected or promised delivery date for the shipment; may be null if currently unknown.
Null if unknown.

expected_delivery_date.description: Expected or promised delivery date; may be null if unknown.

oneOf.description: Timestamp of confirmed arrival for the shipment (UTC). Null if not yet delivered.
Null if not delivered.

delivered_at.description: Timestamp of confirmed arrival if shipment is delivered; null otherwise.

created_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this shipment record was created in the system, for audit and tracking.

updated_at.description: Last updated timestamp (UTC) for this shipment record, reflecting the most recent tracked change.

oneOf.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC). Null if active.
Null if the shipment is active.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this shipment record. Null if shipment is not deleted or is active.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.ISummary.description:
Summary response model for a shipment/fulfillment event related to a customer order.

Used to present summary information on shipment history, current delivery status, or order item fulfillment in customer or seller views. Provides tracking, carrier, and lifecycle state data for each discrete logistics event associated with an order.

Fields match the core properties from the shopping_mall_order_shipments table—tracking number, current status, key timestamps, and references to both order and shipping partner. Provides contextual entity references as .ISummary objects for relational clarity.

id.description: Unique identifier for this audit event—primary key for the audit log record.

order.description: Summary information of the order associated with this audit event. Provides context instead of a raw UUID reference.

oneOf.description: Null if audit actor was not an admin.

actor_admin.description: Admin actor summary if the event was performed by an admin, or null otherwise.

oneOf.description: Null if not performed by seller.

actor_seller.description: Seller actor summary if the event was performed by a seller, or null otherwise.

oneOf.description: Null if not performed by customer.

actor_customer.description: Customer actor summary if the event was performed by a customer, or null otherwise.

action_type.description: Type of audited action (e.g., status_change, address_update, refund_initiated). Identifies the nature of the lifecycle event being recorded.

oneOf.description: Optional serialized details/context for this action in JSON format. May include parameters, old/new values, or event-specific metadata.
Null if no extra action context provided.

details_json.description: Additional event context/parameters in JSON format (optional). Null if not present.

created_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this audit event was recorded.

IShoppingMallOrderAuditLog.ISummary.description:
Summary response object for a per-order audit log event, representing an immutable trace of a significant action or change in order lifecycle.

References contextual entity .ISummary objects for order and potential actors, supporting full business traceability and avoiding N+1 query issues for UI consumers.

IShoppingMallPayment.ISummary.description: Minimal summary for referencing payments. This schema is ONLY used in reference relations in other objects. Keep as lightweight as possible.

id.description: Unique identifier for this payment entity.

method.description: Payment method or channel code (e.g., 'card', 'transfer', 'payco', etc.), as used in lists or client UIs.

amount.description: Total payment amount as booked in financial records, in original transaction currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the payment.

status.description: Current payment status for user display and audit: e.g., completed, pending, refunded, failed, cancelled, etc.

created_at.description: Timestamp in UTC reflecting when the payment was created or booked.

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for a payment refund record, used in lists and references in the shopping mall platform.

Captures the essential refund context, status, amount, and actor references for quick preview and reporting.

Excludes detailed relationship arrays and audit histories. Referenced via payment summaries and refund tracking endpoints.

id.description: Unique refund identifier.

status.description: Refund status (requested, pending, processing, completed, failed, rejected).

reason.description: Reason for refund (as provided on request).

payment.description: Reference to the payment being refunded. See IShoppingMallPayment.ISummary.

processed_by_admin.description: Admin who processed refund, if any. Null if automated or system refund.

processed_at.description: Timestamp refund was processed or finalized. Null if pending.

IShoppingMallPaymentAuditLog.description:
Immutable audit log record for all system or manual actions affecting payment records in the payment component. All reference actors and records are summary objects—not raw UUIDs—providing atomic, contextual display for forensic review and admin dashboards.

Captures details of actions such as payment/reversal/refund events, provider callbacks, admin interventions, system escalations, admin or seller/customer actions. Summary objects are used in all reference slots to avoid N+1 problems; references to payment and payment refund, and involved admin/seller/customer actors (may be null). Intended to be displayed in audit dashboards, compliance logs, and not directly user-managed.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the audit log record.

payment.description: The payment affected by this action (may be null for system/non-payment events). Always a summary reference.

paymentRefund.description: The payment refund record implicated in this audit log, if any (may be null). Reference object instead of ID.

admin.description: Admin who performed the action, when applicable. Reference to .ISummary for context display (null if triggered by system or seller/customer).

seller.description: Seller actor involved, if any (null if action by admin, customer, or system). Provided as summary type.

customer.description: Customer actor involved, if any (null if triggered by admin/seller/system).

action_type.description: Type of action performed (e.g., payment_created, payment_updated, refund_requested, provider_callback, admin_override, escalation, etc).

action_payload.description: Raw payload log of the event or API call (JSON-encoded for callbacks, requests, responses, etc).

created_at.description: Log creation timestamp; matches event time, always immutable.

IShoppingMallReview.ISummary.description:
Summary information about a product review submitted by a customer for a product they have purchased, for list or compact display.

All BELONGS-TO associations are presented as .ISummary objects—never raw ID fields—in accordance with strict atomic operation and relation rules for summary and embedding. The order item is shown only as its UUID, since order item summary type does not exist.

id.description: Primary key for the review.

is_draft.description: Indicates if the review is a draft (not yet published).

moderation_status.description: Current moderation status (e.g., pending, approved, rejected, flagged).

created_at.description: DateTime when the review was created.

updated_at.description: Last update time for this review (includes customer edits and moderator actions).

customer.description: Customer who submitted this review, referenced as an .ISummary for context embedding.

product.description: Product being reviewed, always a .ISummary object.

productSku.description: SKU (variant) of the product being reviewed, as a .ISummary object.

productRating.description: Product rating object for the review, as a .ISummary if rating exists.

orderItem.description: Order item context for reference linking. Minimal structure (currently just UUID).

id.description: UUID referencing the order item for this review.
Unique identifier for the review response. This ID is generated by the system and is used as the primary key to reference each individual review response.

body.description: The textual response from the seller to a customer review. Must contain between 10 and 1000 characters as per business validation rules.

oneOf.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was withdrawn or deleted by the seller, if applicable. Null if response is active.

withdrawn_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was withdrawn or deleted by the seller, if applicable. Null if response is active.

moderation_status.description: Current moderation status for the response. This indicates whether the seller response is visible to customers, flagged for review, or blocked by an admin.

oneOf.description: Optional reason for moderation action such as rejection or flagging. Populated when a response is moderated or rejected by the platform.

moderation_reason.description: Optional reason for moderation action such as rejection or flagging. Populated when a response is moderated or rejected by the platform.

created_at.description: Timestamp representing when the response was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp representing the last time the response was updated.

oneOf.description: Timestamp representing when the response was soft deleted for moderation or admin action. Null if active.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp representing when the response was soft deleted for moderation or admin action. Null if active.

review.description: Reference to the original review that this seller response addresses.

seller.description: Reference to the seller who wrote this response.

sellerSession.description: Reference to the seller session during which this review response was written. This field enables platform auditing and traceability of all seller actions for compliance, fraud prevention, and customer confidence. It is always set for every review response record as required by system audit policies.

IShoppingMallReviewResponse.ISummary.description:
Seller response to a customer review, visible alongside the review on the product or order history page.

Each response is uniquely tied to the customer review and the seller who authored it. Visible to all platform users subject to moderation rules. Includes the core text, status, and traceability metadata for audit and compliance purposes.

Withdrawn and moderation-related fields allow tracking of response lifecycle and platform enforcement actions.

References to the original review and the seller actor enable UI rendering and filtered queries. The sellerSession property records the session in which a response was submitted and is vital for audit, moderation, and business process compliance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product rating record as the primary key.

value.description: Numeric rating value assigned by the customer. Allowed range is from 1 to 5 inclusive, following typical star rating convention.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the product rating was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last change to this rating.

oneOf.description: Soft delete marker, null if rating is active. Indicates when the rating was logically removed from active statistics.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete marker, null if rating is active. Indicates when the rating was logically removed from active statistics.

customer.description: Reference to the customer who assigned this rating.

product.description: Reference to the product to which this rating applies.

productSku.description: Reference to the SKU (variant) of the product being rated.

IShoppingMallProductRating.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a product rating submitted by a verified customer for a specific SKU of a product.

Used for aggregating average ratings, displaying basic rating information in search and product detail pages, or as an embedded reference in reviews or customer history.

Captures the value, actor information, target product and SKU, and traceability for auditing and analytics. Soft deletion state allows accurate recalculation and audit tracing.

id.description:
Primary key.

Uniquely identifies the review status event record. Used for lookup, traceability, and referencing in system logs.

See: shopping_mall_review_status_histories.id

shopping_mall_review_id.description:
The review affected by this status event.

References the review whose status changed. Foreign key to shopping_mall_reviews.id.

actor_customer_id.description:
Optional: Customer who performed this action (if actor is a customer). Null if not a customer-triggered event.

References shopping_mall_customers.id.

actor_seller_id.description:
Optional: Seller who performed this action (if actor is a seller). Null if not a seller-triggered event.

References shopping_mall_sellers.id.

actor_admin_id.description:
Optional: Admin who performed this action (if actor is an admin). Null if not an admin-triggered event.

References shopping_mall_admins.id.

actor_session_id.description: Optional: Session in which the action was triggered. Session type matches the actor type. Null if session context not relevant. References shopping_mall_admin_sessions.id.

status.description:
New status set for the review. Typical values: created, published, rejected, flagged, withdrawn, deleted.

Indicates the post-event state of the review for audit and workflow tracking.

reason.description: Optional explanation for status change (such as admin notes, moderation reasoning, or withdrawal message). May be null if not required or not applicable.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the status event occurred.

Indicates when this review status was set. Immutable once written for audit integrity.

IShoppingMallReviewStatusHistory.ISummar.description:
Summary DTO for review status event history in a shopping mall platform.

Represents a snapshot of a status event (moderation, withdrawal, publication, etc.) for a product review. Provides immutable audit information about the event, including the type of actor (customer, seller, admin), optional session context, status, reason, and precise timing. Supports comprehensive traceability and compliance reporting for business and regulatory purposes. Used in lists, tables, and audit log views where full event context is not needed.

id.description:
Primary key.

Uniquely identifies the admin action log record. Essential for referencing, lookups, and traceability. References shopping_mall_admin_action_logs.id.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description:
Admin actor responsible for action.

Foreign key to shopping_mall_admins.id. Identifies which admin performed the action.

action_type.description:
Categorical type of admin action (e.g., user_suspend, order_refund, role_escalate, config_change).

Enables grouped analysis and filtering in audit log views. Represents the business category or operation instance for the admin action.

context_info.description:
Optional JSON-encoded or text data providing additional context (object state, request params, results, etc).

May be null if not provided or relevant.

created_at.description:
Time the admin action was performed.

Precise timestamp for audit, forensic analysis, and timeline reconstruction. Immutable once written.

IShoppingMallAdminActionLog.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO representing an administrative action or privileged operation in the shopping mall platform.

Captures a single record of admin intervention, system-level event, or role-based action with business relevance. Designed for audit log displays, compliance reporting, and investigatory analysis. Contains essential information about action type, responsible admin, timing, and optional context for complete event traceability without the need for full related entity expansion.

IShoppingMallEscalationQueue.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an escalation event or dispute queue for platform-wide interventions requiring admin, seller, or customer mediation.

Includes the minimum identifying and contextual details needed for list views, bridging cases involving complaints, disputes, unresolved issues, or compliance escalations. Omits verbose details for efficient filtering and aggregation.

Used for quick display in list, queue, or workflow dashboards. Always references the full escalation queue entity but optimized for high-performance summary use-cases.

id.description: Unique identifier of the escalation queue entry. Matches the primary key uuid in the database.

escalation_type.description: Type/category for the escalation event. Common values: refund_dispute, policy_violation, compliance_check, complaint, delivery_exception. Required for business workflow routing.

reason_detail.description: Business or user-provided explanation of the escalation reason. Sufficient context for understanding the core issue at a glance.

status.description: Current state of this escalated case (open, investigating, resolved, closed, rejected, admin_pending, compliance_review). Used for filtering and queue assignment.

priority.description: Priority for triage and handling: low, normal, high, urgent, critical. Guides SLA and operational urgency.

assigned_admin.description: The assigned admin user for this escalation, represented as a summary object if assigned, or null if unassigned. Reference enables UI display and pattern consistency.

created_at.description: When this escalation entry was created.

resolved_at.description:
Time when escalation was closed/resolved. Nullable until resolved. Provides workflow and SLA closure tracking.

This property distinguishes escalations that have reached final resolution from those that are still in process. It provides the timestamp for system queries, analytics, and reporting on operational efficiency and compliance checks. The field is null until the resolution event has occurred.

last_updated_at.description: Latest update timestamp for case assignment, status, or message. Used for recency ranking in queues.

IShoppingMallDispute.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a dispute case within the shopping mall platform.

Represents essential attributes required to display the status, actors, subject, and cause of a dispute, together with temporal markers and audit fields. Used for list displays, context embeddings, and reference relations in more detailed entities.

Omits heavy textual content and composition arrays to ensure lightweight and efficient summary usage.

id.description: Unique identifier for this dispute. Used as a primary key throughout the system.

status.description: Dispute status representing the current phase or outcome (e.g., open, investigating, resolved, rejected, escalated, closed).

subject.description: Brief description or headline summarizing the nature of the dispute (e.g., 'Non-delivery', 'Wrong product sent').

root_cause.description: Primary reason or trigger for the dispute, as identified in the escalation workflow.

resolution_note.description:
Final resolution details or decision note from admin. Nullable until a decision has been rendered.

Captures administrative or system commentary on the result of the dispute, compliance, justification for refund, or any mitigating notes for legal/audit trail. This field is null until a resolution occurs.

customer.description: Customer involved in this dispute. Contains summary actor information.

seller.description: Seller involved in this dispute. Contains summary actor information.

admin.description: Admin handling the dispute, if assigned. Can be null if not determined.

created_at.description: The creation timestamp of the dispute.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for this dispute. Useful for tracking ongoing progress.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp for this dispute, if applicable. Nullable: null indicates the dispute is active; otherwise the field contains the date/time of soft deletion. Used for compliance, retention policies, or audit reporting.

IShoppingMallDisputeMessage.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a message exchanged during the dispute process.

Represents a single communication event between customer, seller, or admin participants in a dispute. Useful for chat history previews, last-message context in dispute lists, or user notification triggers.

Includes soft-delete metadata for admin and audit purposes. The "deleted_at" property indicates if a message is visible or has been removed logically from user-facing UI.

id.description: Unique identifier of this dispute message. Used as the message primary key.

dispute.description: The top-level dispute to which this message belongs (parent context).

role.description: Role of the sender (admin, seller, customer) for message context.

content.description: Actual message content as exchanged between dispute participants.

sender_admin.description: Admin (if any) who sent this message. Null unless role is 'admin'.

sender_seller.description: Seller (if any) who sent this message. Null unless role is 'seller'.

sender_customer.description: Customer (if any) who sent this message. Null unless role is 'customer'.

receiver_admin.description: Admin (if any) who received this message. Null unless receiver is an admin.

receiver_seller.description: Seller (if any) who received this message. Null unless receiver is a seller.

receiver_customer.description: Customer (if any) who received this message. Null unless receiver is a customer.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this dispute message was sent.

oneOf.description: Soft-deletion timestamp. If present, message has been logically deleted; null means message is active and visible in normal UI workflows.
Null if the message is not marked as deleted.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete metadata for audit and admin context. If null, message should be considered active and visible. When populated, indicates the UTC date and time when the message was logically deleted (not removed from database, but hidden from normal user view).

IShoppingMallShipment.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for shipment records, used for list display and reference embeddings. 

Contains key identifying fields, status, and primary foreign references—all transformed into .ISummary objects for consistent summary retrieval.

Ideal for paginated shipment queries or as embedded context within order, tracking, or actor-related endpoints.

id.description: Unique shipment ID.

order.description: Summary reference for parent order.

orderItem.description: Summary reference for the shipped order item (line item).

status.description: Current workflow status.

created_at.description: Record creation time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the return/pickup request (primary key).

order.description: Order this return request refers to. Instead of exposing order_id, provide summary object for immediate context.

orderItem.description: Order item being returned or picked up. Instead of exposing order_item_id, provide summary object for immediate context.

requestedByCustomer.description: Customer who initiated the request (if customer-initiated). Reference object or null.

requestedBySeller.description: Seller who initiated the return/pickup (if seller-initiated). Reference object or null.

shippingPartner.description: Shipping partner assigned to the return/pickup (summary object or null if not assigned).

reason.description: Free-form reason for return or pickup provided by the actor (customer, seller, or admin).

status.description: Current status of the return/pickup request. Valid values: pending, approved, scheduled, picked_up, delivered, completed, rejected, cancelled.

oneOf.description: Address for pickup (may be order delivery address or custom).

pickup_address.description: Full address where the item should be picked up for return/reverse logistics. Nullable before assignment.

oneOf.description: Scheduled pickup time (Asia/Seoul timezone).

scheduled_pickup_at.description: Scheduled date/time for the carrier to pick up the item, or null if not scheduled.

oneOf.description: Tracking code/RMA associated with the return.

provider_tracking_code.description: Carrier-assigned tracking code for the pickup/return shipment.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the return request was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to this return request.

oneOf.description: When the return/pickup was completed. (ISO 8601 UTC)

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the return/pickup was marked completed. Nullable until finished.

oneOf.description: When the return/pickup was cancelled. (ISO 8601 UTC)

cancelled_at.description: Timestamp if this return/pickup was cancelled; null if not cancelled.

IShoppingMallReturnRequest.ISummary.description:
Summary DTO for return, pickup, and reverse logistics requests.

Order and orderItem are provided as summary objects for immediate context.

Customer and seller actors are provided as summary references if available; null otherwise, depending on who initiated the request.

Shipping partner is provided as a reference object (if assigned).

This allows return requests in list/summary views to give sufficient related context for dashboards or audits, while avoiding exposing raw UUID reference fields and N+1 query problems.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.ISummary.description: Summary data type representing a single shopping mall customer session for use in paginated search results or embedded session summaries in customer profile views. Provides a concise view of the session record, suitable for administrative review, account security displays, and session overviews. Includes only business-relevant identifying fields and essential connection context. Sensitive or security-related fields like tokens or detailed device information are excluded.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) for the customer session record.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the session was created.

expired_at.description: The time when this session is set to expire. Indicates session validity window.

last_active_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent activity in this session. Used for determining active/inactive status.

ip.description: Client IP address associated with the session. Useful for security and audit purposes.

href.description: URL (href) representing the landing page or starting point of the session. Useful for tracking where the session originated.

referrer.description: Referrer URL from which the client navigated when establishing the session.

user_agent.description: User agent string of the device/browser that initiated the session.

IPageIShoppingMallProductsCategory.ISumm.description:
A page.

Collection of records with pagination information.

IShoppingMallProductsCategory.IRequest.description:
Filtering, pagination, and search parameters for retrieving category assignments for a product.

This request DTO is used with the 'patch' method to fetch a paginated and filterable list of all category mappings for a given product. It supports pagination, sorting, full-text search on category or metadata fields, and advanced filter extension. Properties should enable clients to efficiently manage and query the product-category relation table, supporting catalog management tools for sellers and admins.

page.description:
Requested page number for paginated results.

Must be a positive integer. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description:
Maximum number of results per page for pagination.

Accepts values between 1 and 100. Larger limits are rejected to prevent inefficient queries.

search.description:
Optional search string for filtering assignments by category name or metadata.

Allows clients to filter returned mapping records by matching the assigned category name, description, or other relevant fields supporting navigation and analytics use cases. Ignored if empty.

oneOf.description:
Sort order for result list. Accepts 'created_at' or 'category_name'.

Determines whether mappings are sorted by date created or by associated category name alphabetically.

Sort order for result list. Accepts 'created_at' or 'category_name'.

Determines whether mappings are sorted by date created or by associated category name alphabetically.

sort.description:
Sort order for result list. Accepts 'created_at' or 'category_name'.

Determines whether mappings are sorted by date created or by associated category name alphabetically.

oneOf.description:
Sorting direction: ascending or descending. Defaults to 'asc'.

Combined with 'sort' to choose sorting behavior.

Sorting direction: ascending or descending. Defaults to 'asc'.

Combined with 'sort' to choose sorting behavior.

order.description:
Sorting direction: ascending or descending. Defaults to 'asc'.

Combined with 'sort' to choose sorting behavior.

IShoppingMallProductsCategory.ICreate.description:
Detailed information identifying the category to be assigned to the specified product, following creation rules for the mapping.

Used as the request body for the assignment of a new marketplace category to a product. The mapped product is provided as a path parameter, while the body references which category to assign. Enforces uniqueness across (product, category) pairs and validates that both referenced entities exist in their respective tables. The core use case is for catalog assignment flows supporting product discoverability, navigation, and business-driven categorization.

shopping_mall_category_id.description:
Assigned marketplace category. Must be an existing ID from the 'shopping_mall_categories' table.

This field references the category to map the product to. The system will validate this value and ensure it is not already mapped for the target product.

IShoppingMallProductsCategory.description:
Represents the mapping of a catalog product to an additional browsing category within the marketplace platform.

This entity is a subsidiary (junction) mapping table row—each instance identifies the inclusion of a single product in a specific category, supporting multi-category assignments for merchandising, search, and navigation. The mapping allows the same product to appear in multiple categories, enhancing discoverability and aligning with business strategies. Each record enforces a unique combination of product and category, referencing both the parent product and the assigned marketplace category via object relations for complete reference context. The model includes a creation timestamp for audit and history purposes.

id.description: Primary key that uniquely identifies this product-category mapping.

product.description: Summary information for the catalog product associated with this category assignment. Replaces the raw shopping_mall_product_id UUID for richer context. References the shopping_mall_products table.

category.description: Summary information for the assigned category. Replaces the raw shopping_mall_category_id UUID for richer context. References the shopping_mall_categories table.

created_at.description: UTC ISO8601 timestamp for when this mapping was created.

IShoppingMallProductsCategory.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a shopping mall product category for list, search, and reference usage.

Represents a single node in the product category/taxonomy tree, providing the minimum data necessary for navigation, display, or category context embedding. This summary omits large description fields and relationship arrays.

It derives from the shopping_mall_categories table. Category hierarchy may be indicated through parent_id when required elsewhere.

id.description:
Unique identifier (UUID) for the product category.

Primary key. References the shopping_mall_categories.id column. Used in selection, navigation, and embedding.

name.description: Unique category name for display, navigation, and reference lookups. Sourced from the name column in shopping_mall_categories.

scenario.draft: Test successful customer registration with unique email, complex password (at least 8 characters, uppercase, lowercase, digit, and symbol), legal full name, and valid phone number. Confirms that the registration process creates a new account and returns a valid JWT token set in the response. Verifies basic business flow for onboarding new shoppers.

Test registration attempt with an email address that is already registered. Confirms that the system enforces email uniqueness and returns the appropriate error, preventing account creation with duplicate email as required by business rules.

dependencies.purpose: Register the initial account to occupy an email address.

scenario.draft: Test successful login for a registered customer using correct email, password, connection URL, and referrer. Verifies the system authenticates valid credentials and returns expected JWT tokens in the response.

dependencies.purpose: Register a new customer to later log in with those credentials.

scenario.draft: Test login attempt with a valid registered email but incorrect password. Verifies the login fails and appropriate error is returned, confirming secure password validation and error messaging as per business rules.

dependencies.purpose: Register a customer to enable login attempt with correct email.

scenario.draft: Test login attempt with an email address that is not registered in the system. Confirms that login fails as expected with correct error handling for non-existent emails.

Test login attempt with missing or malformed 'href' or 'referrer' fields. Confirms system rejects authentication attempts that lack required session context as defined in API schema and security policy.

dependencies.purpose: Create a valid customer (though context is broken for this login attempt).

scenario.draft: Test retrieval of a paginated, filtered list of messages for a specific dispute by an authenticated admin. Validates advanced filtering, sorting, pagination, and proper authorization for the admin actor. Covers the workflow for reviewing disputes, including searching by sender, receiver, role, content, date range, and pagination settings. Ensures the admin receives correct results only for messages linked to their accessible disputes, with unauthorized queries blocked. Assesses business rule enforcement around actor relations, dispute visibility, and compliance requirements.

dependencies.purpose: Authenticate as admin to create and review disputes/messages in admin context.
Create a new dispute as admin to supply a dispute context for filtering messages.

Essential authentication prerequisite:
This join operation (post /auth/admin/join) must be executed before any operations requiring 'admin' actor authorization.
It establishes the necessary user account and authentication context for the 'admin' actor, enabling subsequent API calls that depend on this specific authorization level.
Without this join operation, the main scenario endpoint and its dependencies will fail due to insufficient authentication credentials.

scenario.draft: Test retrieval of all dispute messages for a dispute as an authenticated seller. Validates seller authorization, correct dispute linkage, and verifies that filtering, sorting, and pagination features function for sellers. Checks that only messages for accessible disputes are returned and that the search can be filtered by sender, receiver, content, role, and date range. Focuses on seller's perspective of reviewing and managing communications in dispute workflows. Ensures prerequisite of dispute existence is fulfilled.

dependencies.purpose: Authenticate as seller to gain access for viewing disputes/messages.
Admin must create a dispute to provide a valid dispute context for seller message access.

Multi-actor authentication setup:
This join operation (post /auth/seller/join) is required to establish a 'seller' actor user account in the system.
This scenario involves multiple authorization actors, requiring separate user accounts for each actor to properly test cross-actor interactions and authorization boundaries.
The join operation creates the foundational user identity that will be used throughout the test scenario for 'seller' specific operations.
This join operation is required for the 'seller' actor authentication.

Actor switching authentication:
This login operation (post /auth/seller/login) enables dynamic user actor switching during test execution for the 'seller' actor.
In scenarios with multiple actors, the test agent needs to authenticate as different users to simulate real-world multi-user interactions.
This login operation ensures proper session management and authorization context switching, allowing the test to validate permissions, access controls, and business logic that span across different user actors within a single test scenario.
This login operation may be required for user actor swapping between multiple actors.

Multi-actor authentication setup:
This join operation (post /auth/admin/join) is required to establish a 'admin' actor user account in the system.
This scenario involves multiple authorization actors, requiring separate user accounts for each actor to properly test cross-actor interactions and authorization boundaries.
The join operation creates the foundational user identity that will be used throughout the test scenario for 'admin' specific operations.
This join operation is required for the 'admin' actor authentication.

In scenarios with multiple actors, the test agent needs to authenticate as different users to simulate real-world multi-user interactions.
This login operation ensures proper session management and authorization context switching, allowing the test to validate permissions, access controls, and business logic that span across different user actors within a single test scenario.
This login operation may be required for user actor swapping between multiple actors.

scenario.draft: Test that a platform admin can search and paginate shopping mall payment records using advanced filtering options (status, method_type, currency, amount range, date range, customer/provider ID, sorting, and pagination). The scenario ensures that only authenticated admin actors can access the payments search and receive results. Validates correct filter application and response pagination for administrative reconciliation and reporting use cases.

The test includes creating a new seller account, registering a product as the seller, and then querying the SKU list endpoint with different combinations of SKU status, code search, price range, and stock range using the supported filter fields. scenario.draft: Test the soft deletion (deactivation) of a shopping mall order by a platform administrator. This scenario verifies that a newly registered admin can authenticate, then soft-delete an order using its unique business order number, and that the order is marked as deleted (deleted_at timestamp is set) and excluded from future business workflows. The test covers the full authorization flow and ensures administrative permissions are correctly enforced.
